events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-005 status=queue spec="In the Dodo dashboard: regenerate the live API key and the webhook signing secret, then paste both into app/.env.local. I will restart the dev server and re-run the checkout probe. The onboarding centre Worker (revops-centre) also stores a Dodo webhook secret for its /hooks/dodo route: update it there too, or /hooks/dodo will fail signature checks. The secret it holds today belongs to the disabled staging endpoint; when the live Dodo endpoint for /hooks/dodo is created it brings its own secret, so store that one in the Worker."

events.text: I updated T-005's spec and done_when so the rotation also covers the Dodo webhook secret stored in the centre Worker, which belongs to the disabled staging endpoint. T-005 stays in queue until after launch, R-835b0027 is acked and the change is committed.
